# Hmm no change in top crop. Maybe UP moved bottom green? Let's crop bottom region
def crop(frame, r0, c0, h, w):
    lines = frame.ascii.splitlines()
    out = []
    for i in range(r0, r0+h):
        line = lines[i] if i < len(lines) else ''
        out.append(line[c0:c0+w] if len(line)>=c0+w else line[c0:])
    return '\n'.join(out)

# MOUSE at (40,10) caused only HUD changes (row 54-63). So MOUSE on green did nothing? Or maybe MOUSE selects? Let's see history of MOUSE actions.
mouse_indices = [i for i,h in enumerate(history) if h.action.startswith('MOUSE')]
print('mouse indices', mouse_indices[:10])
# Check effect of first mouse
if mouse_indices:
    i = mouse_indices[0]
    before = history[i-1].frame if i>0 else None
    after = history[i].frame
    # compare nodes
    if before:
        b_nodes = {n['hash']: n for n in before.segmentation['nodes']}
        a_nodes = {n['hash']: n for n in after.segmentation['nodes']}
        changed = []
        for h in set(b_nodes)|set(a_nodes):
            b = b_nodes.get(h)
            a = a_nodes.get(h)
            if b and a and b['boundary']!=a['boundary']:
                changed.append((h, b['color']))
        print('first mouse changed nodes', changed)
